description: Scores how organic a corpus of UNATTRIBUTED, scraped sentiment signals (crawled mentions, imported reviews with no verifiable identity, aggregator feeds) looks, weighing a positive composite of consensus/diversity/volume/recency against a heuristic penalty for two specific patterns: evidence concentrated in a single source type, and unusually uniform sentiment (near-maximal with near-zero variance). Neither pattern establishes fabrication, and source types are counted without verifying that they are independent. It cannot show that sentiment is fabricated or that any reviewer is fake, and varied sentiment spread across several sources isn't caught by these two checks. The score is not a sentiment ranking: the composite rewards positive consensus, so a strongly negative corpus scores lower than the same corpus with the sign flipped (with the example configuration, 20 signals at -0.9 across four source types score 46; at +0.9, 68), and an honest negative corpus can rank below a fake-looking positive one. Source labels are compared trimmed and case-folded ('Forum' and ' forum' are one type), and a source type counts as one only when its credibility x confidence is high enough (`config.fullCountWeight`), so the counted source types can be fewer than the labels. Treat a low score as 'looks statistically unusual in a specific way worth a human look', not as a finding. Signals with zero confidence, zero source weight or fully decayed recency carry no weight; a source type that is not a key of `config.sourceWeights` has credibility 0; when no signal carries weight, confidence is 'insufficient' and trustScore is null (no score is reported). Use this for reviews/mentions/buzz with no identity behind them. For signals from known, identified contributors, use score_trust_identified instead.

config.description: Partial override merged over the library's illustrative EXAMPLE_ANONYMOUS_CONFIG -- omit to use the example config as-is.

concentrationSourceCeiling.description: Source count at/under which single-source concentration is penalized.

minSignalsForUniformCheck.description: Minimum signal count before the pattern checks apply at all.

uniformMeanThreshold.description: Mean sentiment above this is a candidate for the uniformity penalty.

uniformVarianceThreshold.description: Sentiment variance below this is a candidate for the uniformity penalty.

astroturfWeight.description: How much the pattern penalty (the kit's `astroturf` rules) is subtracted from the positive composite.

fullCountWeight.description: [trust-core 0.3+] Credibility x confidence a source type needs to count as one full source type (default 0.425); a lighter one counts in proportion. On the same scale as sourceWeights x confidence.

volumeSaturation.description: Source count at which the log-scaled volume term saturates to full credit.

weights.description: Relative weighting of the four positive components.

now.description: ISO 'now' timestamp recency decay is computed against. Pass a fixed value for determinism.

signals.description: The unattributed signals to assess. May be empty.

id.description: Identifier for this signal, for reference in the output.

publishedAt.description: ISO date the material was published, or null/omitted if unknown.

source.description: Key into config.sourceWeights -- the source type. The library's illustrative example uses 'forum'|'community'|'marketplace'|'aggregator'|'blog'|'social'; supply your own via `config.sourceWeights`. A source type that is not in sourceWeights has credibility 0, so that signal carries no weight.

name: assess_anonymous_authenticity
title: Score how organic unattributed signals look
